title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on John 20: the empty tomb, Mary at the garden, and the risen Jesus with his disciples and with Thomas.

questions.text: Who went to the tomb early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark?
questions.explanation: John 20:1 says Mary Magdalene went early to the tomb while it was still dark and saw the stone taken away.

questions.text: What did she tell Simon Peter and the other disciple?
questions.explanation: She said that they had taken away the Lord out of the tomb and that she did not know where they had laid him.

answers.text: That the tomb was still sealed
That the Lord had been taken out of the tomb
That the guards had run away
That she had spoken with the Lord

questions.text: Which of the two running disciples reached the tomb first?
questions.explanation: They both ran together, but the other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

answers.text: They arrived at the same moment

questions.text: Where was the cloth that had been on Jesus' head?
questions.explanation: The cloth from his head was not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

answers.text: Folded at the door of the tomb
Rolled up in a place by itself

questions.text: What did Mary see when she stooped and looked into the tomb?
questions.explanation: She saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

answers.text: A young man with the guards

questions.text: Who did Mary suppose the man standing there to be?
questions.explanation: She did not know that it was Jesus and supposed him to be the gardener, so she asked where he had laid the body.

questions.text: What did Jesus say when he stood among the disciples behind locked doors?
questions.explanation: On that first day of the week, with the doors locked, Jesus came, stood in the middle and said, "Peace be to you."

answers.text: "Do not be afraid of the Jews."
"Why do you stand looking at me?"

questions.text: What did Thomas say he needed before he would believe?
questions.explanation: Thomas said he would not believe unless he saw and touched the print of the nails and put his hand into Jesus' side.

answers.text: To hear it from the angels
To see the empty tomb himself
To touch the nail prints and his side
To watch Jesus eat with them

questions.text: What did Thomas answer when Jesus told him to reach out his hand?
questions.explanation: Thomas answered him, "My Lord and my God!"

questions.text: Why does the writer say these things were written?
questions.explanation: They were written so that readers may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life in his name.

answers.text: So that the signs would not be forgotten
So that readers may believe and have life in his name
So that the disciples could remember his words
So that the Scripture might be fulfilled
